frozen_v3_delta.F1_final_assembly: After the COMPLETE returned result is assembled, decide_and_commit performs one more ORIGINAL deadline check before return. Failure re-assembles in memory as HELD (P5_DEADLINE_AFTER_ACK when ACK succeeded, else P5_DEADLINE); no further I/O. New result field final_deadline_check: PASSED | CROSSED | NOT_PERFORMED_ALREADY_CROSSED | BASE_EXCEPTION | NOT_PERFORMED (exception-attachment paths). A BaseException from that check fires P5_BASE_EXCEPTION and re-raises with a HELD parent_release_result. No hard real-time return guarantee.
frozen_v3_delta.F2_native_completion: New _Txn.native(stage, function, *args, retain=None, after_ack=False): full original check BEFORE the call (crossed latch => no new I/O), native call, primary Exception logged (bounded event + digest) then the SAME original check (secondary retained separately; secondary BaseException keeps primary context), primary re-raised; returned ownership/progress retained by a non-raising retain hook BEFORE the completion check. Routed through it: os.open (inside _Txn.open), every os.fstat/os.stat(lstat)/os.read/os.pread/os.write/os.fsync/os.fstatvfs/os.scandir/next(iterator). os.close/iterator.close are cleanup: always permitted for owned handles, followed by the original check unless already crossed. Thread txn through _write_all/_pread_exact/_write_new/_registry_tail/_append_registry. Deadline BaseException now also latches crossed (original deadline unavailable).

Commit-phase BaseException now fires P5_BASE_EXCEPTION, chains any pending evaluation BaseException as context, and propagates with a HELD parent_release_result (pure in-memory assembly, no I/O). Partial dispositions/registry bytes are never removed.
